deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout flow
Independent third-party smart-contract audit with published remediation
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22/ADA, over 8 months with milestone-based disbursement.
Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and was funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary ticket marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and public launch amplification.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism that sends 25% of all fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and runs 350+ events annually at current cadence.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is described as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move $6M+ through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88M historical 2025 revenue.
Intersect is stated to administer the budget through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with independent oversight and public on-chain tracking via treasury.sundae.fi.
The proposal states that the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Anvil/Sellout state that they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request for an enterprise ticketing expansion with milestone-gated delivery, repayment commitments, oversight structures, and substantial adoption projections, but many core adoption, prior investment, and deployment claims are stated by the proposer rather than evidenced inside the document.
